note: Synthetic sample class. Answers were written to include common Class 8 misconceptions; 'marks' are reference marks set by hand following samples/answer_key.txt, used as ground truth by eval/evaluate.py.

answers.Q1: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants make their own food (glucose) using sunlight. They take carbon dioxide from air and water from soil, chlorophyll traps the sunlight. Oxygen is given out. carbon dioxide + water -> glucose + oxygen
answers.Q2: Iron rusts when it reacts with oxygen and moisture (water) in the air. To prevent it: 1) painting 2) galvanisation (coating with zinc)
answers.Q3: Speed = distance / time = 150 km / 3 h = 50 km/h
answers.Q4: Light travels much faster than sound, so the light reaches us first even though both are produced at the same time.
